breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still includes 'Calculate the second moment of area I using the formula I = π d^4/64,' which perpetuates the original error by retaining I as a calculation step in a torsion problem. The ground truth resolves this by completely removing any mention of using I = πd⁴/64 in torsion relations. While the generated spec correctly uses J in the torsion formulas (τ_max and φ), the continued presence of the I calculation step still echoes the original inconsistency rather than fully eliminating it.
